title: Burrito Bowl Bar Night
seoTitle: Burrito Bowl Bar Night | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Chipotle-style bowl bar with carnitas and fixings for ten
subtitle: Chipotle-style bowl bar with carnitas and fixings for ten
description: Slow-roasted carnitas, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, corn salsa, and classic burrito toppings fill a build bar. Crew assembles bowls or burritos with as much or as little heat as they want.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Burrito Bowl Bar Night in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch pork. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Slow-cook carnitas
steps.instruction: Season pork with cumin, salt, and pepper. Braise with orange juice and lime covered at 300°F until tender and internal temp reaches 195°F, about 3 hours. Shred with forks. Target oven/smoker temperature: 300°F.

steps.title: Crisp for service
steps.instruction: Spread shredded carnitas on sheet pans and broil 5 minutes until edges crisp and brown. Verify held temp stays above 165°F before placing at the bar.

steps.title: Prepare rice and beans
steps.instruction: Cook rice and finish with lime juice and chopped cilantro. Season black beans with cumin and garlic. Keep both hot in hotel pans on the line.

steps.title: Set the bowl bar
steps.instruction: Arrange rice, carnitas, beans, corn salsa, lettuce, cheese, sour cream, and hot sauce in order. Warm tortillas wrapped in foil as an optional wrap upgrade.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 145°F with a 3-minute rest. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Portion and open the line
steps.instruction: Portion Burrito Bowl Bar Night onto sheet trays or hotel pans for family-style service. Stack plates, forks, and napkins at the end of the line so late-arriving crew can self-serve without bottlenecking the cook.

steps.title: Scale for larger halls
steps.instruction: When cooking for more than 10 firefighters, split into two pans halfway through so the bottom layer does not overcook while the top waits — duplicate mise en place if you double batches.

steps.title: Service and portion guidance
steps.instruction: Suggest starting with rice, protein, beans, salsa, then cold toppings. Replenish crisped carnitas from backup pans under the broiler as needed.

steps.title: Final quality check before service
steps.instruction: Walk the line once before opening service for Burrito Bowl Bar Night — confirm hotel pans are labeled, backup trays are in the 200°F oven, and thermometers are calibrated. Rookies should ask a senior cook to spot-check the first portion.

proTips: A spoon of carnitas fat crisped in the pan before broiling adds authentic flavor.
Pickled red onions as a topping cut richness and the whole bar.
Offer half-rice/half-lettuce base for anyone avoiding heavy carb loads.
tonightSpread: Burrito bowl bar with crispy carnitas, rice, beans, and full topping station.
Tortilla chips and queso on the side for crews wanting chips-and-dip alongside bowls.
leftovers: Carnitas freeze well—re-crisp and reuse on taco night next week.
Mix leftover bowl components into a baked enchilada casserole.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Burrito bowl bars are familiar, fast, and filling. Carnitas can be made ahead and crisped before service, and the format handles extra hungry members without recipe changes.
mealPrepNotes: Cook carnitas low and slow the day before, then crisp under the broiler before service. Rice should be cilantro-lime finished just before the bar opens. Keep hot and cold zones separate.
